name: Storms of Sea
storyline: The seas are ruled by storms, pirate crews and monsters from the deep. As a young captain with a small ship, you sail out to make your name: hunt pirates, fight rival captains, and join a fleet to take islands and their towers. Only one captain can rise to the top and become the Master of the Seas.
summary:
Storms of Sea is a free-to-play pirate MMORPG for Windows and Android. Sail a vast open sea, upgrade your ship and cannons, hunt pirate ships and sea monsters, and fight real players in real-time naval battles.

Join a fleet, conquer islands and towers together, and climb the rankings to earn your place among the most feared captains. Your ship, your fleet and your battles shape your legend.
